documents.subject: Request for payroll context and settlement status
documents.body:
Hello,

We are reviewing the payroll record dated 2025-12-31 for Meridian Ledger Labs, Inc. The record identifies payroll ID PAY-012 and shows gross, withholding, employer, and net amounts. Please provide any available explanation or supporting context for this record and clarify whether any related external movement has been confirmed. Under the stated settlement policy, proposals are not settlements, and only confirmed external movements are settled. No payment or additional approval is established here. Please reply with the relevant details or identify what remains unknown.

documents.body: On 2025-12-31, Meridian Ledger Labs, Inc. recorded payroll ID PAY-012. documents.subject: Settlement policy excerpt
documents.body:
Service and settlement excerpt, dated 2025-12-31:

For Meridian Ledger Labs, Inc., only confirmed external movements are settled; proposals are not settlements. This excerpt does not establish that a movement occurred, that a proposal was made, or that any approval or payment exists in connection with payroll ID PAY-012. Any operational application of this policy should be supported by confirmation of the relevant external movement. Missing explanations should be requested rather than supplied by assumption. This excerpt preserves the policy as provided.
